description: DDP integrated-sync training benchmark on 4x Ascend 910B2 (reviewer requirement R2). Times zero-grad + forward + squared-loss + backward WITH DistributedDataParallel gradient synchronization (all-reduce of gradients). Optimizer update (elementwise, identical for both arms) excluded as documented. 3 repeats x 5 measured iterations each, barrier + device-sync around every iteration, max-over-ranks timing.
key_findings: Dense synchronized train step: 15.23±0.19 ms (grad all-reduce dominates: 15.23 vs 5.02 unsynced)
MWG-EW synchronized train steps: 4.80-5.31 ms across ranks 32-512
Synchronized train-step speedup vs dense: 2.87x-3.17x (mean ~3.05x) with real gradient all-reduce on world size 4
The dense gradient volume (3dm params) makes its all-reduce the bottleneck; MWG-EW's r(d+m) gradient volume syncs ~3.4x faster
Rank r512 has the lowest speedup (2.87x) as its larger gradient volume approaches dense communication cost
This closes reviewer R2: a real DDP-synchronized training step measured on ASI2 at 8B-scale geometry
